notes.title: Concordia: Digital Edition Update v1.3.6 is Here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/e0ace360f2922c2c907f72dcd1b168658d089d37.jpg

We’ve just released version 1.3.6, focusing on bug fixes based on your helpful feedback. ✨

[Fix] Resolved an issue preventing card purchases when the Magister card was played on the Consul or Senator.
[Fix] Fixed a softlock occurring after playing the Diplomat card on the Magister.
[Fix] Implemented minor stability improvements.

And while you're here, we’ve got exciting news: Inkborn, a roguelike deckbuilder, which is our first original game project (not a digital adaptation of board game) is set to release on Early Access in Q2 2025! 🖤🖋️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580

What sets Inkborn apart? 🃏
Inkborn introduces an innovative card combo system, where players unlock powerful moves by sequencing cards strategically - bringing the excitement of classic fighting game combos into a fresh and unique twist. Combined with our distinctive Origami-inspired art style and a dynamic roster of evolving character classes, every run offers a new and exciting experience. At launch, you'll have access to over 100 different cards to experiment with, and we’re just getting started - expect more characters and cards to be added post-launch! Full Release 👉 Q2 2026.

Make sure to update Concordia: Digital Edition to enjoy the latest improvements, and as always, let us know if you encounter anything else! 🎮

notes.title: Concordia: Digital Edition Update v1.3.3 is Here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/91c5bbb00a3d7839447cde066c58997c20fce22c.png
Update 1.3.3 for Concordia: Digital Edition is now live! Based on your feedback, we've made improvements to enhance the app's functionality. This update primarily addresses bugs and issues reported by our dedicated community. 🥳

In addition, we've added 24 new Steam achievements, offering new challenges and rewards for players to discover as they continue exploring the game. Enjoy these new features and dive back into Concordia: Digital Edition! Check out one of the most interesting:

Cedant arma togae, concedant laurea laudi (Win against hard AI opponent without deploying any Colonists from the Storehouse.)
Pecunia non olet (Own at least 50 Sestertii at the end of your turn.)
Alii sementem faciunt, alii metunt (Gain at least 2 Goods during an opponent's Prefect action.)

And here is the list of implemented fixes and features:

[Feature] Added more detailed information to the Province Summary and Points panel in Team Mode.
[Feature] Introduced 24 brand-new Steam achievements to unlock.
[QoL] Updated recommended number of players for Ionium Reduci map.
[QoL] Added outlines to Colonists and cities on the map for better visibility.
[QoL] Increased camera zoom-out range on Aegyptus and Germania maps.
[QoL] Minor AI improvements on the Germania map.
[QoL-Controller] Added vibration feedback at the start of each turn.
[Fix] Fixed the skip Colonist buying animation in the tutorial.
[Fix] Fixed the undo of a Prefect action in the tutorial.
[Fix] Updated localization for improved language support.
[Fix] Fixed issues with selecting options from Architect/Prefect cards when using the Sextus Pompeius forum tile.
[Fix] Corrected an error that occurred when playing the Mamilius tile on the Germania map.
[Fix] Fixed a bug that caused an inability to choose a personality when the Magister card was played immediately after a card with multiple personalities.
[Fix] Resolved an issue where the icon of the last card played was incorrect after loading the game.
[Fix] Fixed player color discrepancies in the Diplomat card selection window.
[Fix] Fixed artifacts in the recruitment animation.
[Fix] Corrected tree animation issues.
[Fix] Removed beta content settings.
[Fix] Resolved display issues with the Publius forum tile (cost display and warning popup).
[Fix] Fixed Magister action with double personality cards and adjusted Magister card animations.
[Fix] Improved automatically selects add-ons based on the last game played.
[Fix] Fixed camera movement range when zooming with pinch gestures on the touch screen.
[Fix] Minor stability and performance improvements.
[Fix-Controller] Fixed gamepad controller focus after closing the pause menu during the tutorial.
[Fix-Controller] Fixed confirmation and skip functions for Roman fortresses on the Germania map.
[Fix-Controller] Improved text for the final step of the tutorial when using a gamepad controller.

notes.title: Get ready for a major update for Concordia: Digital Edition!
notes.notes:
Get ready for a major update for Concordia: Digital Edition! Make sure to finish all your solo and multiplayer games by October 22nd to avoid losing your progress. Before we roll it out, there's some important information to keep in mind. 👇

This update introduces key changes, making old game saves incompatible and inaccessible. Any attempt to load these older saves will fail. We are dedicated to offering long-term support for our game, ensuring seamless cross-platform compatibility for the best experience. In order to make it possible, we had to implement some breaking changes. 🗓️

On the bright side, the patch will bring exciting new features and fixes, including Steam achievements! So, wrap up your current games, safeguard your progress, and prepare yourself for the great trading adventure! 🥳

notes.title: Update ver 1.2.2 is live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28141325/dfdc4b1ec5712b00ca35ca4e77bd7f3fcc9ba9a3.jpg

Update ver 1.2.2 is live. 

Here's the full list of changes: 


 [Fix] Fixed the display of long Province names bugging out in the province summary screen.
 [Fix] Fixed the display of gained Sestertii with Donatus Pompeius Forum Card.
 [Fix] Fixed the highlight remaining after returning to the draw pile screen.
 [Fix[ Fixed the action log display in online games. 
 [UX] Now the card details will automatically close when we open the detailed description of a Forum Card.
 [Fix] Fixed the bug where Laurentius Forum Card was displayed as playable during AI turn.
 [Fix] Fixed the card display visual bug when we swapped the hand view during opponent's turn.
 [Fix] Fixed the Numerius Forum Card - the wrong amount of Sestertii was displayed, and the popup info wouldn't go away.
 [Fix] Gaius Marcellus Forum Card now correctly increases the Mercator action gain.

notes.title: Update ver. 1.1.0 - Live Play
notes.notes:
The long-awaited full first patch is live and with it some noticeable changes based on your very own feedback! 

Most noticeable of which will be the different map views (accessible from the game itself) and the Live Play option for the online play (aka synchronous mode) - where the game needs to be played in one sitting.

Here's the full list of changes: 


 [Map] Added map options - toggle lower saturation view and House construction cost on and off.
 [Colonist] Colonists should be contrasting better in the Perspective (3D) Mode. We're still working on 3D Colonist models, so those are yet to come.
 [Camera] You can now toggle camera following your opponents' moves on or off. 
 [Online] We have added Live Play online game mode, where players agree to play the entire game in one sitting. Leaving the room means forfeiting. In case of disconnect - you have 3 minutes to come back.
 [Audio] Added production sound, end turn sound and new music!
 [Fix] All players will now properly see the Good-to-Sestertii conversion window at the end of an online game. 
 [Fix] Fixed dropdown menu view. 
 [Fix] Fixed the tooltip when waiting for your turn.
 [Fix] Fixed the rotating animation of the Player icon when they need to make a decision (considering) in the online game.
 [Fix] Fixed the 2D colonist animation during a replay.
 [Fix] Point calculation animation will not trigger multiple times when someone leaves the room in an online game.
 [Fix] Fixed a bug where we couldn't select any Goods with an overflowing Storehouse during a Prefect action.
 [Fix] Chat button will no longer be showing up in the Tutorial.
 [Fix] Fixed the podium display for 4th, 5th and 6th place.
 [UI/UX] Improved the visibility of your own Points.
 [Rulebook] Added icons to the Online Play section. Added Live Play to the rulebook's Online Play section.
 [Fix] Fixed the points visibility module. Now it actually hides the points.
 [Fix] Fixed a rare bug where we couldn't make our move when making a decision during someone else's turn.



This is a repost of a previous patch - update done for better visibility - given it's an important update!

notes.title: The second patch, v1.0.3.1 is live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/a8fb2f00a1a7cb4908ddb9103b98d6379a298627.png


The second patch, v1.0.3.1 is live!

We've patched up a couple of bugs and introduce a few changes to the camera behaviour. We've updated the end game animations as well and (we believe) they are much fancier now :)

The Live Game mode is now in beta testing and we hope to release it in the very next patch. Keep your finger crossed! We're still working on improving the visibility of the board elements as well. 

Onto the changelog!

 [Shiny] New end game scoring animations. The screen should, if nothing else, look more engaging now.
 [UI/UX] Aquilea City name graphic receives a lifting for improved visibility.
 [UI/UX] We added tooltips in various places throughout the game and the menus.
 [UI/UX][PC only] Added a checkbox to turn edge scrolling on/off.
 [UX/Camera] From now on you can move a camera during opponent's moves animation in order to stop the campera from jumping around. Where you place it - it will stay.
 [UX/Camera] Increased the max zoom-out distance on larger screens. Larger meaning tablets, laptops, desktops, etc. Everything above 6 inches.
 [UI] Improvements to UI visibility on mobile devices. Most notably: the PM icon, the hand of Cards, fixes to the 2D Colonists.
 [Fix] Fixed a bug with graphics not loading properly on PC with system language set to Turkish.
 [Fix] Fixed a bug where during the replay, the view jumped between different players' perspectives.
 [Fix] Fixed a bug where during the replay, the screen with information about the last played card remained on the screen.
 [Fix] Fixed a bug where the player couldn't choose a color when joining an empty room (online).
 [Fix] Fixed the tooltip about trying to build more than 15 Houses. Now it shows up after the 15th House, not before.
 [Fix] Colonists inside the City will no longer be clickable (as they shouldn't).


Don't forget to join our community on FB and share your feedback about the game! https://www.facebook.com/groups/concordiadigitaledition/

notes.title: The first post-release patch, v.1.0.2 is live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/e22e9caa64bafe5b7c80030e6420dd159d8e6008.png


The first patch, v1.0.2 is live!

First of all - thank you for all the feedback. We've patched up couple of bugs, and we're working hard on incorporating some QOL changes based on your most requested features - like Live Game mode for online play or increased visibility of certain game elements. 

So, in short - keep the feedback flowing, your voice does matter. 

Onto the changelog!

 [PC/Mac Only][Fix] Fixed the missing localization of the confirm button in the Resolution options screen.
 [PC/Mac Only][Fix] Fixes to the controller navigation in the Tutorial
 [Fix] Fixed the visual bug with "disappearing" discarded cards after a Senator action (buying a card).
 [Fix] Fixed the occiasional crash after constructing the last House in certain languages (i.e. Italian)
 [Fix] Fixed the occasional crash in the tutorial.
 [Fix] Fixed the occasional crash when leaving the game.
 [Fix] Fixed the navigation using the pop-up messages in the online play. 
 [Fix] Numerous small fixes to the display of Players Panel when moving between games.
 [Fix] Several typos amended.
 [UI/UX] Colonists should now be more visible on the map.
 [UI/UX] Added a warning after selecting an inactive Province during a Prefect action.
 [UI/UX] Small improvements to the Colonists visibility in the colorblind mode. 


Don't forget to join our community on FB and share your feedback about the game! https://www.facebook.com/groups/concordiadigitaledition/
